text:
katie-docs: FYI I opened a tiny docs PR to clarify retention vs legal holds for audit exports and add tiny SDK migration guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1137

mike-ops: Nice. Can we be explicit that there's an internal immutable evidence journal used for SOC2 that is different from user-downloadable export artifacts? Folks keep conflating them.

katie-docs: Good point. I'll add a sentence: 'An internal immutable evidence journal is retained per contractual obligations; exported artifacts are subject to tenant retention and legal hold controls.'

andrew-sdk: For SDK authors: recommend checking export.status for a new held state and surfacing a clear message. Also include a tiny code example for handling an unknown status value.

katie-docs: Drafting examples — short curl and node snippets and a JSON response sample. Example response I added: {"export_id":"exp_hold_001","status":"held_by_legal","legal_hold":true,"hold_reason":"investigation","retention_seconds":0}

ida-legal: Suggested wording tweak: use 'suspend automated deletion' instead of 'prevent deletion' — that reflects manual disposition paths. Also please include 'requires documented disposition' phrase.

katie-docs: Done — added verbatim: 'Legal holds suspend automated deletion and require documented disposition before permanent removal.'

mike-ops: Also add ops note: our cleanup service ignores records where metadata.hold_token != null; when the hold_token is cleared the retention countdown resumes from that moment. Keeps things deterministic.

katie-docs: Added an ops note and a short bullet mapping: retention_seconds -> scheduled deletion; hold_token/legal_hold -> exclude from scheduler; evidence_journal -> retained per SOC2.

andrew-sdk: For migration: suggest client fallback policy: if status not in known set, show 'Export pending review' and include contact info. Small code snippet included.

compliance-bot: Reminder: run SOC2 semantics linter and tag @legal-review before merge.

katie-docs: Running linter locally, tagging legal in PR description, and adding a changelog entry: 'Clarify export retention vs legal hold; add SDK migration examples and ops notes.' Will merge after legal signoff.
